questions.question: Which is the largest species of shark in the world?
questions.hint: The Whale Shark is the world's largest fish, growing over 18 meters (59 feet), and feeds mainly on plankton.

questions.question: Which tree species is considered the tallest in the world?
questions.hint: Coast Redwoods (Sequoia sempervirens) include the tallest known living tree, Hyperion, standing over 115 meters (379 feet).

questions.question: Which fictional detective lives at 221B Baker Street?
questions.hint: Sherlock Holmes, created by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, famously resides at 221B Baker Street in London.

questions.question: Which film won the Academy Award for Best Picture at the 2024 Oscars?
questions.hint: Christopher Nolan's Oppenheimer won Best Picture at the 96th Academy Awards.

questions.question: Which organization is responsible for coordinating the Olympic Games?
questions.hint: The IOC oversees both the Summer and Winter Olympic Games.

questions.question: Which country was the first to grant women the right to vote in national elections?
questions.hint: New Zealand became the first self-governing country to grant women voting rights in 1893.

questions.question: Which city was the capital of the Byzantine Empire?
questions.hint: Constantinople, now Istanbul, served as the Byzantine Empire's capital for over 1,000 years.

questions.question: Which treaty officially ended World War I?
questions.hint: Signed in 1919, the Treaty of Versailles formally ended the state of war between Germany and the Allied Powers.

questions.question: In golf, what is the term for one stroke under par on a hole?
questions.hint: A birdie means completing a hole in one stroke fewer than its designated par.

questions.question: Which country invented table tennis?
questions.hint: Table tennis originated in England during the late 19th century as an indoor version of lawn tennis.

questions.question: Which country has the longest coastline in the world?
questions.hint: Canada has a coastline of more than 240,000 kilometers, the longest of any nation.

questions.question: Which is the highest waterfall in the world?
questions.hint: Angel Falls in Venezuela has a total height of 979 meters (3,212 feet).

questions.question: Which blood type is known as the universal donor?
questions.hint: O-negative blood can generally be transfused to patients of any blood type in emergencies.

questions.question: Which vitamin is primarily produced by the body when skin is exposed to sunlight?
questions.hint: Sunlight triggers the production of Vitamin D, which is important for healthy bones and immune function.

questions.question: Which country is the birthplace of the Olympic Games?
questions.hint: The first ancient Olympic Games were held in Olympia, Greece, around 776 BC.

questions.question: Which famous museum is home to the Mona Lisa?
questions.hint: Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa is displayed in the Louvre Museum in Paris.

questions.question: Which animal has the highest blood pressure of any living creature?
questions.hint: Giraffes require extremely high blood pressure to pump blood all the way to their brains through their long necks.

questions.question: Which capital city sits on both the Danube River and was once two separate cities named Buda and Pest?
questions.hint: Budapest was formed in 1873 by uniting Buda, Pest, and Óbuda.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of electrical resistance?
questions.hint: Electrical resistance is measured in ohms (Ω), named after physicist Georg Ohm.

questions.question: Which civilization is credited with creating the first known democracy?
questions.hint: Ancient Athens developed one of the earliest known systems of direct democracy during the 5th century BC.
